d: Company Description Ateeqi Customs Clearance connects businesses and suppliers by providing customs clearance, land transportation, and regional freight coordination for shipments bound for Kuwait. The company specializes in general cargo and refrigerated transport, with a focus on fresh fruits and vegetables from Egypt, goods from Jeddah, and other regional shipments. Ateeqi Customs Clearance emphasizes clear communication, practical planning, and attention to each shipment’s specific requirements to support reliable delivery. Its core services include customs clearance, refrigerated transport, cargo handling, and shipment coordination. The company aims to build long-term partnerships with businesses seeking dependable logistics support between international suppliers and operations in Kuwait.

Role Description The Truck Driver role at Ateeqi Customs Clearance is a full-time, on-site position based in Kuwait City. The Truck Driver is responsible for safely operating company trucks to transport general cargo and refrigerated goods between ports, warehouses, and customer locations, following assigned routes and schedules. Daily tasks include performing pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections, securing and protecting cargo, assisting with loading and unloading when required, and maintaining accurate delivery documentation. The role involves coordinating with dispatch and operations teams, adhering to all relevant traffic and safety regulations, and reporting any delays, incidents, or mechanical issues promptly. The Truck Driver is expected to maintain a professional demeanor with customers and partners, contributing to reliable and timely deliveries.
q: Valid CDL Class A license and proven Truck Driving experience with commercial vehicles.
Ability to safely operate and maneuver different types of Trucks, including vehicles used for refrigerated transport.
Knowledge of DOT Regulations and local traffic laws, with a strong focus on safety and compliance.
Capability to assist with Unloading and basic cargo handling while following safe lifting and handling practices.
Clean driving record and history of punctual, reliable attendance.
Basic vehicle inspection and troubleshooting skills to identify and report maintenance needs.
Strong communication skills to coordinate with dispatch and operations teams.
Ability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, or holidays as required.
Previous experience in freight, logistics, or refrigerated transport is an advantage.
